CustomField.description: Internal Ops / manager distribution address that receives a copy of every branded inspection report when it is sent at close-out (NeuraFormReportDistribution). Leave blank to send only to the brand contact. Per repo convention this is a hierarchy custom setting field and is intentionally NOT included in the perm sets (matches Scoring_Enabled__c et al).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Ops/manager email that gets a copy of each branded report sent at inspection close-out. Blank = brand contact only.
CustomField.label: Report Notification Email
